seo.title: Industrial e-Court Bangladesh: Case Study
seo.description: How Spectrum built the Industrial e-Court system for Bangladesh's labour courts: online case filing, cause lists published online, SMS hearing alerts and digital case files.

hero.title: Industrial *e-Court* Bangladesh
hero.lead: How Spectrum moved Bangladesh's labour courts from paper files to an online system, so cases can be filed, scheduled and followed without visiting the court.

sections.title: At a glance
body: Workers and employers take their disputes to Bangladesh's labour courts. Spectrum built the Industrial e-Court system so these cases can be filed, scheduled and followed online instead of through paper files.

items.label: Client
items.value: Ministry of Labour and Employment and the Labour Courts of Bangladesh

items.label: What we built
items.value: An online case management system for the labour courts

image.alt: Industrial e-Court Bangladesh portal home page

sections.title: The problem
body: The labour courts ran on paper. Case files were kept in physical dockets, hearings were scheduled by hand, and summons were delivered in person, which was slow.
Factory workers often had no way to check their next hearing date without travelling to the court.

sections.title: What we built
sections.intro: One online system for the whole life of a case:

items.title: Online case filing,
items.text: so a case can be started without paper forms.

items.title: The daily cause list published online automatically,
items.text: showing which cases are heard and when.

items.title: Digital case files on the judge's bench,
items.text: instead of folders passed around the courtroom.

items.title: A case log that shows every change,
items.text: so records cannot be quietly altered.

items.title: SMS alerts
items.text: to tell the people involved about hearing dates and orders.

items.title: File the case
items.text: The case is filed online with its documents.

items.title: Schedule
items.text: Hearings are scheduled and the cause list is published online every day.

items.title: Notify
items.text: Parties get SMS alerts about their hearing dates and orders.

items.title: Hear and record
items.text: The judge works from the digital file, and every order is saved to the case record.

sections.title: Results
bullets: Scheduling delays cut by 85%, because the cause list is published online straight away.
Cases can be tracked without paper by workers, employers and lawyers across all labour court benches.
Hearing notices and orders are sent digitally, with a record of who did what and when.

items.title: Case workflow engine:
items.text: moves each case through filing, hearing and judgment in the right order.

items.title: Digital signatures (PKI):
items.text: show who approved each order and that it has not been changed.

items.title: Automatic cause lists:
items.text: built from the case records every day.

items.title: SMS gateway:
items.text: sends hearing alerts to the people involved.
